tools.name: drift_summary
tools.description: Free. How many pinned models and package versions in the ai-agents-for-beginners course have drifted from upstream reality, broken down by lesson and severity. Returns a signed receipt committing to the full findings set. No payment required.

tools.name: verify_report
tools.description: Free. Verify a report receipt's Ed25519 signature, and optionally check that a findings array matches the hash the receipt committed to. Use this before paying to confirm the seller is describing real work, and after paying to confirm you received all of it.

tools.name: drift_report
tools.description: Paid ($0.25). Every drift finding with file path, line number, what is wrong, and the suggested fix - enough to open a PR without re-deriving anything. Verifiable against the free summary's findings_hash.

tools.name: drift_report_x402
tools.description: Paid ($0.25, x402/USDC). Same full drift report as drift_report: every finding with file path, line number, what is wrong, and the suggested fix. Pay with x402 if you hold USDC; use drift_report to pay by card or other MPP methods.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: drift_report, site_audit_summary · Private data: drift_report, drift_report_x402, site_audit_summary · Public sink: site_audit_summary · Destructive: site_audit_x402.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: drift_report, site_audit_summary · Private data: drift_report, drift_report_x402, site_audit_summary · Public sink: site_audit_summary · Destructive: site_audit_x402

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
